write.bin/vibe:
#!/bin/sh
if [ "$1" = --version ]; then
printf '%s\n' 'vibe 1.2.3' 'second line'
exit 0
fi
out=''
while [ $# -gt 0 ]; do
  if [ "$1" = --output-dir ]; then out="$2"; fi
  shift
done
mkdir -p "$out"
case "$out" in
*/setup-checks/vibe-mistral-small/critic/export)
printf '%s\n' '{"config":{"enable_mcp":false,"enabled_tools":["read_file"],"include_project_context":false,"outside_workdir":"deny"},"cost_usd":0.002,"usage":{"input_tokens":1200,"cached_input_tokens":200,"output_tokens":300}}' > "$out/export.json"
printf '%s' '[{"type":"message","role":"user","content":[{"text":"q"}]},{"type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"text":"```json\n{\"findings\": [], \"no_findings_reason\": \"setup check: nothing to review\"}\n```\n"}]}]'
printf '%s' '' >&2
exit 0
;;
*)
exit 9
;;
esac
